segments.sn23.23:1.2: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā rādho bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn23.23:1.3: “sādhu me, bhante, bhagavā saṃkhittena dhammaṃ desetu, yamahaṃ bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto vihareyya”nti.
segments.sn23.23:2.1: “Yo kho, rādha, māro; tatra te chando pahātabbo, rāgo pahātabbo, chandarāgo pahātabbo [sīhaḷapotthake pana “tatra te chando pahātabboti ekaṃ suttaṃ, tatra te rāgo pahātabboti ekaṃ suttaṃ, tatra te chandarāgo pahātabboti ekaṃ sutta”nti evaṃ visuṃ visuṃ tīṇi suttāni vibhajitvā dassitāni. evamuparisuttesupi].
segments.sn23.23:2.3: Rūpaṃ kho, rādha, māro; tatra te chando pahātabbo, rāgo pahātabbo, chandarāgo pahātabbo [sīhaḷapotthake pana “tatra te chando pahātabboti ekaṃ suttaṃ, tatra te rāgo pahātabboti ekaṃ suttaṃ, tatra te chandarāgo pahātabboti ekaṃ sutta”nti evaṃ visuṃ visuṃ tīṇi suttāni vibhajitvā dassitāni. evamuparisuttesupi].
segments.sn23.23:2.4: Vedanā māro; tatra te chando pahātabbo…pe…
segments.sn23.23:2.5: saññā māro; tatra te chando pahātabbo…pe…
segments.sn23.23:2.6: saṅkhārā māro; tatra te chando pahātabbo…pe…
segments.sn23.23:2.7: viññāṇaṃ māro; tatra te chando pahātabbo…pe…
segments.sn23.23:2.8: yo kho, rādha, māro; tatra te chando pahātabbo, rāgo pahātabbo, chandarāgo pahātabbo”ti. 183.
segments.sn23.24:1.1: Yo kho, rādha, māradhammo; tatra te chando pahātabbo, rāgo pahātabbo, chandarāgo pahātabbo…pe…. 184.
segments.sn23.33:1.1: Yo kho, rādha, samudayadhammo; tatra te chando pahātabbo, rāgo pahātabbo, chandarāgo pahātabbo…pe…. 12.

lines: Tathāgatassa imaṃ theraṃ disvā sukhumaṃ kāraṇaṃ upaṭṭhāti.
Evaṃ imasmiṃ rādhasaṃyutte ādito dve vaggā pucchāvasena desitā, tatiyo āyācanena, catuttho upanisinnakakathāvasena.
Sakalampi panetaṃ rādhasaṃyuttaṃ therassa vimuttiparipācanīyadhammavaseneva gahitanti veditabbaṃ.
Sukhumaṃ kāraṇaṃ upaṭṭhāti, tenesa thero paṭibhāneyyakānaṃ etadagge ṭhapito.
